title: Rare and unknown monsters
summary: Creatures hunters have hardly ever met.

claims.text: Beyond bloodsuckers, shapechangers, sorcerers, demons and the walking dead, hunters run into rare, fleeting and bizarre beings that have seldom been seen before.
Some such creatures echo human folklore and modern urban legends, from sewer alligators to killers with hooks, while others defy understanding altogether.
Wrong guesses and overconfidence carried over from known monsters have led hunters to terrible ends against these.
Not only creatures carry the supernatural: settings and places can be tainted or haunted too and threaten what hunters hold dear, whether they know it or not.
One such account deals with a darkness born of the sea.
